supersedes: thinking-v1: rejected costume drift, wink, tight cell margins
prompt:
EDIT THE PROVIDED IMAGE, preserve its character design exactly.
The supplied image is the ONE AND ONLY visual reference. Remake its 6-column by4-row sheet as24 consecutive FRONTAL THINKING animation frames of this EXACT same girl. Keep her original short compact proportions, face, eye size, curls, segmented horns, small wings, right-side hair flower, open-front long white layered dress, original silver ornament work, waist flower, leg strap, white shoes and right-side curled scaled tail. In particular COPY THE ORIGINAL BODICE in the reference: its off-shoulder curved white cups and pale silver central jewelry. Do NOT invent black vertical lines, corset bars, a simplified sleeveless top, a different neckline, a different skirt or longer body.
Make EXACTLY6 equally spaced columns and4 equally spaced rows on a4:3 landscape canvas. All24 whole-body figures have the identical scale, centered torso, fixed shoe baseline and unchanged head/body dimensions. Each cell has at least6% empty transparent padding around all of the figure, especially horn tips and tail. No figure may enter another cell. No frame numbers, no lines, no floor, no shadows, no text. Background is actual alpha-zero transparency, including all spaces between hair strands and limbs. Erase all detached dust, coloured speckles, white halos or stray fragments outside the silhouette; clean soft alpha edge only.
CHANGE ONLY the small head/arm/eyelid motions necessary for this gentle2-second loop. Do not redesign or restyle.
Frames1-6: start with original relaxed arms, gently raise her own RIGHT hand (screen-left) towards her chin, with smooth small intermediate elbow and wrist angles, not a jump.
Frames7-8: fingertips arrive at chin, head gently tilts toward hand (only4 degrees); other hand stays relaxed with a tiny up/down sway.
Frames9-12: blink BOTH EYES TOGETHER: frame9 BOTH half-closed, frame10 BOTH fully closed, frame11 BOTH half-open, frame12 BOTH open. This is a two-eye blink, NEVER a wink.
Frames13-16: keep fingertips softly at chin, slight thoughtful head tilt, very tiny sleeve and hair follow-through. SAME small face, same eye width, same hairline and dress texture.
Frames17-24: gradually lower the hand and gently straighten the head, fully returning to the starting pose by24 so24→1 loops without a jump.
Both feet planted throughout. Exactly two connected arms and hands, no anatomical distortion. No torso bending. No character growth or shrinking. Do not animate by changing the face shape, hair details, clothing design, body proportions or illumination. Preserve the first reference figure as the character model across EVERY cell.
